title: Growing stairs
instructions: A variable is a name that holds a number, and you can change it while the program runs: steps++; adds 1 to steps. Each stair is one bigger than the last, so climb them all using 4 commands or fewer.
note: steps--; takes 1 away and steps += 2; adds 2. A variable made inside loop() starts over every time loop() runs, so make it above, outside every function.
hint: Both parts of a stair, up and across, are steps cells long. After each stair, make steps one bigger with steps++; so the next stair is bigger too. Watch the Serial Monitor to see it count.
